summary.text: Christina Marudas is the Green Party candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Democrat Jason Morgan and Republican Miriam Corvino.
She advanced from the Green Party convention on April 25, 2026, and was also the Green Party candidate for the seat in 2024, when she received 2.5% of the vote.
